en.title: Delete Products to Leave At Most k Categories
en.description:
Delete some products so that at most k distinct categories remain; find the minimum number of products deleted. Every individual item of the same category counts.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k; the second line contains the categories. 1≤n,k,category≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 0 and 2. When k exceeds the actual number of categories, nothing needs to be deleted.
hints: Sort the category frequencies in descending order, keep the k most frequent categories, and delete everything else.
